tbesh_html:
1) to tithe, take the tenth part of, give a tithe, take a tithe
1a) (Qal) to tithe
1b) (Piel) to give a tithe
1c) (Hiphil) to take a tithe

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to tithe, i.e. to take or give atenth
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (identical with H6238 (עָשַׁר)); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), [idiom] truly.
